Job Purpose

The Dominican air travel market has experienced steady growth in the last few years and Arajet will be a catalyst for the rapid expansion of the air transportation market in the Dominican Republic and the Caribbean as a whole. New traffic to and from the island will provide direct and indirect employment opportunities and have a significant positive impact on the regional and national economy.

At Arajet we want to provide the opportunity for more people to fulfill their dream of flying. To do this, we are looking for aviation professionals with whom we can make the dream of many come true. We are looking for professionals like you, with longings for growth, experience, and desire to leave their mark on the history of Dominican commercial aviation.

We are currently seeking experienced Captains for our B737-MAX aircraft who will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of flight to ensure safety and the proper functioning of all aircraft systems during normal operations. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in ensuring compliance with both local and foreign regulations, as well as adhering to the policies and procedures outlined by the company's operations.


Minimum Requirements

  • Type rate on B737 NG/MAX (preferably).
  • Current American Visa B1/B2 (if required).
  • Current First Class Medical.
  • ICAO Level 4 ENGLISH Language Proficiency.
  • Current ATP License.
  • Equal or more than 5,000 total hours.
  • 1,500 hours PIC on aircraft with MTOW of 45 tons or greater.

JOB PURPOSE:

The AP Assistant will report to the VP of Accounting and is responsible for ensuring prompt processing, evaluation and reporting of a large volume of expense records for payment. The Assistant should be a person that is self-motivated, understands the accounting principles, fosters a culture of teamwork, and is proficient in Microsoft Office products, especially Microsoft Excel.

﻿﻿KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Leadership

· Track progress and provide status updates of longer-term projects. Communicate with other

team members and outside consultants to ensure projects are completed in a timely manner.

Operational Excellence

· Identify areas for improvement and suggest alternative ways of doing-thing to ensure efficiency and accuracy

Planning

· Develop closing processes and improvements to closing processes to ensure long term accounting accuracy.

Stakeholder Management

· Communicate concisely to management status of various accounting balances and details of those balances.

Regulatory and Other

· Ensure accounting methods, balances, and procedures are compliant within the applicable reporting framework (IFRS).

﻿﻿QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, & SKILLS:

· 2-3 years of Accounts Payable experience

· Accounting student or graduate, or related fields.

· Conversational in English
